rejected.claim: Many air conditioners turn on permanent magnets.
rejected.reason: Ambiguous causal wording: magnets are components of motors, not the energy supply. Revised to the blower motor application.

rejected.claim: Another AI will find ways to make them.
rejected.reason: Overstates prediction as successful synthesis; source promises predicted chemical pathways.
No immediate test schedule is reported; pipeline includes making candidates before validation.

rejected.claim: The goal is reliable domestic materials for motors.
rejected.reason: Reliability could be read as proven material performance; source describes more reliable domestic sourcing and manufacture.

rejected.claim: A better replacement magnet now exists or powers an air conditioner.
rejected.reason: Announcement funds a research pipeline and sets a future commercialization milestone; no replacement result is established.

rejected.claim: The award happened today or was executed on September 1.
rejected.reason: September 1 is the university article date; September 13 is this Dispatch date. No executed-award date verified.

rejected.claim: The umbrella initiative has a reconciled funding total.
rejected.reason: UH body gives $100 million, while the linked federal page title gives $72 million; the fetched federal body was empty. Omit the umbrella total; no amounts enter verified claims.
